hoaxes.title: Moonshot will ship Kimi K3.1 Pro on a stack of 40 USB sticks for offline users
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Moonshot released Kimi K3.1 Pro's 2.8-trillion-parameter weights on Hugging Face, where they topped the trending list.

hoaxes.title: Godzilla Minus Zero IMAX screenings will hand out cardboard skylines to stomp
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Godzilla Minus Zero opens November 6 on 3,254 screens and is projected to make about $30 million.

hoaxes.title: Ocarina of Time remake lets players import their 1998 Nintendo 64 save files
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The Switch 2 remake launches November 5 with a 96 Metascore, the highest-rated game of 2026 so far.

hoaxes.title: Apple's OLED iPad mini comes with a foldable stand shaped like a tiny MacBook
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The OLED iPad mini starts at $699 with an 8.5-inch screen and A20 Pro chip, and Gizmodo rated it 4 out of 5.
